item.title: Largest Context Window Open LLMs: Pushing AI Memory Boundaries in 2026
item.description: The largest context window open LLM refers to open-source large language models capable of processing and retaining an exceptionally large amount of text data in a single pass. This allows them to maintain coherence and recall information from extensive conversations or documents, pushing the boundaries of AI memory. As of April 2026, the landscape of the largest context window LLM is rapidly evolving, with open-source models increasingly competing with proprietary giants.
